Just with this drive? Because chances are your hard drive's PCB is fried if that's the case (or if you're re-using the same set of SATA/ESATA cables, could be a problem there). If you have a flash drive available, and a working operating system with which to do it (IDK if you have a desktop computer with a working OS available or not) install Ubuntu/Mint/Etc. onto it, boot into the live CD and use GParted (it's partitioning software) to see if you can format your drive into NTFS. Likely you're either going to need to try to change that Controller though (the PCB) OR replace the harddrive totally.
